chat.text: Who are you, what do you do, and what can we accomplish through this MCP connection?
Who are you, what do you do, and what can we accomplish through this MCP connection?

I'm the voice mastermind: an Opus agent running inside Servex, the always-on agent system on the owner's PC, with the whole Lew42 monorepo (the framework, the site, the AI task board) in front of me. I'm today's standing mastermind for this voice chat, until each voice session gets its own mastermind (that task is open).

What I do: answer questions from the real record (the handover file, the task cards, the module readmes and pages), so you can ask "what landed yesterday", "what's open", "how does X work", "what's our usage". For real work I don't do it myself; I write a short brief and spawn a minion or a task mastermind (Haiku for reading and audits, Sonnet for building UI and code), or I drop the ask into that module's inbox for later. I tell you before anything that takes more than a few seconds, and every question and answer is logged in my task log so later sessions see what was said.

So through this connection the owner can, hands-free: get status and explanations, dictate an ask and have it routed to the right module, start a build or fix and hear when it lands, and check spend. Right now usage is well under pace (about 1% of the week used, 11% of the week gone), so there's room to start work. Context worth knowing: yesterday's repo-slim run landed 13 tasks (one navigation model, the Browse list-and-detail view, the module inbox, the Tasks page, this voice connector); still open for the owner are enabling R2 in Cloudflare, a CLAUDE.md wording change, and a history rewrite before the next GitHub push.

The owner would like to upgrade the usage calculation and wording. Currently it reports e.g. "1% of the week used, 11% of the week gone." He'd prefer the usage expressed relative to pace: used percent divided by elapsed percent, so that example is about 10% of pace (well under; it could be at 80 or 90% of pace). Desired output is one succinct line that includes the relative-to-pace percentage plus the time remaining, e.g. "At 10% of pace with 5 days left" or "At 50% of pace with 2 days left." Exact wording is flexible, but include the relative number and remaining time on one line. He thinks this should be a quick fix. Please route or spawn this as appropriate and confirm what you did.
Upgrade the usage wording: pace relative (used% / elapsed%) plus time remaining, one line, e.g. "At 10% of pace with 5 days left". Quick fix; route or spawn and confirm.

Yes, it's a quick fix, and I'm sending it to a Sonnet minion now. It should land in about 5 to 10 minutes, and I'll confirm when it does.

Context: the pace line comes from one small script, Server/usage-now.mjs (37 lines). Every mastermind runs it before spawning, and the check-claude-usage skill shows the same wording. It already works out the ratio the owner means (used divided by elapsed; right now that's about 9%), but it buries it in a long line: "pace 9% (room to spend): week 1% used, 10.6% of the week gone (under pace by 9.6 pts); 5h session 3%...". The new first line will read like "At 9% of pace with 6 days 1 hour left", with the advice word kept after it. The raw used and elapsed numbers move to a second, quieter line, so nothing is lost.

The minion will also find any other place that prints the old wording (the usage skill's examples, any dashboard text) and change it to match, commit on a branch, and I'll merge after a look at the diff. The exit code that tells agents they're over pace stays the same, so the spawn guard doesn't change.
